maria.g: quick triage from Saffron-7B int4 smoke: cost per token ~46% lower vs fp16 on our benchmarks. good throughput but we see a consistent recall hit on multi-turn summarization and list-heavy outputs. short notes below.
aj: short bullets pls
maria.g: - multi-turn summarization (>4 turns or >1200 tokens): ROUGE-L down ~6 pts
- list/bulleted outputs: missing items or reordered answers
- single-turn chat and short FAQ ok
- inference p95 improved ~11ms
neil: any layer-localization for the error?
maria.g: drift map points to KV projections in mid layers; per-channel KV quant improved recall by ~2-3 pts. tested configs: group=64 symmetric MLQ (baseline) vs group=32 per-channel percentile (better for recall). pasted small qcfg used: `{"precision":"int4","kv":"per-channel","mlp_group":32,"calibration":"percentile"}`
eva: routing recommendation? full rollout risky.
neil: mixed-fleet. route short chat and autocompiles to int4; detect longform/list-heavy via token_count > 1024 OR payload contains more than 3 list markers ("-"/"1.") -> route to int8. shadow longform to int4 for 14d.
aj: can product add header for task-type?
maria.g: product agree to add `X-RW-Task: longform|chat|rerank`. aj will coordinate.
neil: canary plan: 3% traffic for 72h, automated evals every 6h on sampled longform slices, rollback if ROUGE-L drop >5 pts or complaint rate +1%. human-eval 50 longform samples pre-canary.
maria.g: econ math: routing 65% short->int4 (exclude longform) nets ~28% org token savings; all-in int4 nets ~47% but incurs UX risk. recommend conservative mixed-fleet.
eva: mitigation experiments during canary: group-size sweep (16/32/64), per-channel KV calibration, and a hybrid mid-layer int8 build.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: `saffron7b-int4-canary` -> starts 2026-03-27T04:00Z, 3%.
aj: I'll open the routing PR and ping product for header. maria.g: i'll draft the short rec doc + cost table and share with GTN by Monday. thanks team :thumbsup:
